deities.name: Torvald the All-Watcher
deities.description: Chief deity of the northern clans. Honored with roasted meats, crushed barley, and tempered blades on granite mountain altars.

deities.name: Skadi the Frostmaiden
deities.description: Goddess of snowbound paths and silent hunters. She grants enduring stamina to those who respect the sacred winter woods.

deities.name: Varn the Shrouded
deities.description: Guardian of ancestral resting places and ruler of the cold underworld beneath the permafrost.
